title: Rocket-Lovers Watch OSIRIS-REx Launch
description: OSIRIS-REx launched Thursday, September 8 at 7:05PM on an Atlas V rocket on a journey to study asteroid Bennu and return a sample to Earth. Thousands of visitors watched the launch, some of whom were part of a NASA Social event.
keywords: OSIRIS-REx, OSIRIS, Bennu, asteroid, sample return, launch, 12368
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
